verdict.rationale: Chargebee's docs confirm scheduled dunning retries and "Smart Retry" logic that varies intervals dynamically based on gateway decline type, directly supporting automated, optimized retry cadences aimed at recovering failed renewal payments. However, missing for 10: no quantified recovery-rate data, no explicit claim of ML-based optimization (only 'dynamic intervals based on error type'), and no independent/customer evidence measuring actual involuntary-churn recovery impact.
